            idx += 2
        degree = [0] * (n + 1)

        for a, b in edges:
            degree[a] += 1
            degree[b] += 1
            adj[a].append(b)
            adj[b].append(a)
        leaves = [i for i in range(1, n + 1) if degree[i] == 1]
        operations = []
        while len(leaves) > 2:
            new_leaves = []
            while len(leaves) > 1:
                u = leaves.pop()

                operations.append(f"{u} {adj[u][0]} {v} {adj[v][0]}")
                degree[adj[u][0]] -= 1
                degree[adj[v][0]] -= 1
                if degree[adj[u][0]] == 1:
                    new_leaves.append(adj[u][0])
                if degree[adj[v][0]] == 1:

            leaves.extend(new_leaves)
